laguiche1551.summary: Claude de la Guiche, in Rome, reports to Montmorency that the Sienese envoy has left Rome with Dom Diego (Diego Hurtado de Mendoza, imperial ambassador and master of Siena) and that the Count of Santa Fiora is discontented and would readily come over to the king's service on conditions; the winter of the Parma war, months before the Sienese rising of July 1552. The first two struck-through lines read only in part.
laguiche1551.en:
Struck through by the writer: ⟨[…] Die[go] […] to put in prison in this [?town] […] a [?Sienese] […] believe
th[at] […] informed the⟩

⟨trial, which I have found means to see⟩, in order to inform the said Lord Cardinal of its contents, so that on that
basis he may lay such foundation as he shall think fit, ⟨in the negotiation you have heard of.⟩ And also to tell the
said Lord Cardinal the remarks which [?Mignet] made to ⟨the ambassador of Siena who was here, who has left to return
to Siena with [Dom Diego] […]⟩. And since the said Lord Cardinal has begun to write to you of this affair, I shall
refer to what he will write to you of it. I hear that ⟨the Count of Santa Fiora is ill satisfied with [::], and that
he would easily come over to the King's service⟩ […] of the Seance […] ⟨the service⟩ […].

system: La Guiche: a simple substitution of 22 invented signs for the 22-letter alphabet, no word division.
